objective: Define the bounded writeback contract that governs how recompute execution infrastructure may be used after the post-plan recompute-monitoring path is pending completion, including baseline capture, dry-run defaults, explicit live-writeback opt-in, observation refresh obligations, and mirror discipline.

phase_plan.requirement: Materialize one explicit writeback contract surface before any canonical recompute mutation path is considered
Confirm the post-plan recompute-monitoring path remains pending completion before execution is classified as a support action rather than a completed state transition
Capture baseline values from current canonical surfaces before any recompute output generation
Execution tooling must expose explicit dry-run versus live-writeback selection and default to dry-run
The default orchestration path must clone live recompute surfaces into a non-canonical dry-run workspace before writing computed outputs
All three recompute surfaces must materialize outputs under the same bounded execution bundle and emit a machine-checkable bundle summary
Canonical recompute surfaces may be mutated only when live-writeback mode is explicitly selected and an allow-live-writeback guard is provided
Any completed recompute execution path must route next to recompute observation and post-recompute observation refresh
Authority mirrors may register the writeback contract and dry-run readiness, but must not overstate live recompute completion without actual canonical output writeback and downstream ruling refresh

non_claim_boundary: Repository-local recompute live-writeback contract only; no scientific adequacy claim and no implied live recompute completion.
